components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Paper-filled uppercase CTA for Hablemos and product paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; background: #F7F5F0; color: #0B1220; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFFFF; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4A574; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Nav Outline CTA
components.description: Trailing nav Contacto control; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.55rem 1rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #F7F5F0 55%, transparent); color: #F7F5F0; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-nav:hover { background: #F7F5F0; color: #0B1220; border-color: #F7F5F0; } .ds-btn-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C4A574; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Contact Pending
components.description: Non-interactive placeholder until a real contact channel ships.
components.css: .ds-contact-pending { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.85rem 1.5rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #F7F5F0 35%, transparent); color: #A8B0BD; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 0; cursor: default; user-select: none; }

components.name: Quiet Link

components.name: Demand Board

components.css: .ds-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; max-width: 48rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #F7F5F0 18%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #F7F5F0 18%, transparent); } .ds-board span { padding: 0.85rem 1rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, #0B1220 55%, transparent); color: #A8B0BD; font-family: "Public Sans", sans-serif; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-board span:first-child { color: #C4A574; } @media (max-width: 52rem) { .ds-board { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }

narrative.overview:
LIRN’s commercial surface reads as an executive mobility house: deep navy cyclorama, warm off-white paper, Bodoni Moda editorial display, and Public Sans as the quiet UI voice. Sections alternate night / paper / night-soft like a printed dossier, not a SaaS dashboard. Photography is cinematic and full-bleed; champagne is a sparse signal, never a theme wash.

Primary system of record: `lirn-web-main` (LIRN home + `/torns`). The TORNS Operate dashboard in `tro-frontend` inherits the same token family (night, paper, ink, champagne) with operational status colors; it is a sibling skin, not a clone of the landing composition.

Rejected by the build and brand commitments: flat night network diagrams as hero, cyan/glow TRO, TransMilenio red as brand, glass/neon, generic consulting templates, and invented clients, metrics, or testimonials.
keyCharacteristics: Luxury editorial + minimalist corporate on a night/paper rhythm
Bodoni Moda display + Public Sans UI; sharp corners; hairline rules
Champagne as scarce accent; paper-filled primary CTA (Hablemos)
Full-bleed cinematic hero with dual gradients; no card chrome
Same token family across LIRN site and TORNS Operate mode

rules.name: The Scarce Champagne Rule
rules.body: Champagne marks a first signal in a set (board, instrument triad, mission). It must stay rare: if removing it would not change hierarchy, it should not be there.

rules.name: The Night/Paper Rule
rules.body: Commercial pages alternate section-dark, section-paper, and section-soft. Do not flatten the whole site to one ground.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda owns brand, product mark, and section headlines. Public Sans owns navigation, buttons, labels, and body. Do not invert.

rules.name: The First-Viewport Rule
rules.body: Hero contains brand, one headline, one support line, Hablemos + TORNS, and an optional discrete demand/estación/oferta board — not stats, trust bars, or card grids.

rules.name: The Flat Editorial Rule
rules.body: Landings: no ambient card lift. If a surface needs separation, use hairline or night/paper contrast — not blur or glow.

rules.name: The Sharp Edge Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce soft radii, pills, or floating rounded media cards on LIRN commercial surfaces.

dos: Do keep Hablemos as the primary commercial CTA and TORNS as secondary navigation/product path.
Do alternate night / paper / night-soft sections with hairline rules and cinematic photography.
Do reuse night, paper, ink, champagne tokens in TORNS Operate so the family reads as one house.
Do treat Transmilenio (or any operator) as public problem context — never as client proof.
donts: Don't use network/diagram SVG, cyan glow, or “red nocturna” flat maps as the hero idea.
Don't invent clients, metrics, testimonials, trust logos, or fake demos.
Don't flood screens with champagne or use status red/green as brand color on landings.
Don't ship rounded cards, glassmorphism, neon, or Inter/Roboto/system display stacks as the house face.
